# Hi, I'm Arailym 👋
![](images/8C4D86EB-F44F-4D63-A253-0F525C95C8AA.jpeg){width=250}
I'm a Master's student in **Applied Business Analytics at Boston University**, interested in using data to understand business problems and support better decisions.

## About Me

I have a background in **Mathematical and Computer Modeling** and am currently pursuing my Master's degree in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University.

My experience combines **data analysis, project management, and technology**. Before graduate school, I worked on projects involving cross-functional teams, process improvement, and digital solutions. These experiences helped me develop an interest in how data can be transformed into practical insights for businesses.

Through my graduate studies, I am developing my skills in **Python, SQL, data visualization, statistical analysis, and business analytics**. I enjoy working with real-world datasets, identifying patterns, and communicating results in a clear and practical way.

Outside of academics, I enjoy **exploring Boston, traveling, discovering new places, and learning new tools and technologies**.

## Projects

### Business Analytics & Data Analysis

I work with real-world datasets to explore patterns, relationships, and trends using Python and data analysis techniques.

### Marketing Analysis

I apply analytical methods and business frameworks to understand customers, markets, and business performance.

### Decision Making

I use quantitative and strategic approaches to analyze business problems and evaluate potential solutions.

### Data Visualization

I create visualizations that make analytical findings easier to understand and communicate to a broader audience.

More projects and analyses will be added as I continue building my portfolio.
